result.rationale: The diff line `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }` in app/assets/javascripts/embed.js does indeed use substring matching instead of strict origin equality, so any event whose origin happens to be a substring of the forum URL (e.g., a URL like 'http://evil' matching 'http://evil.com/...') would pass the check. The mechanism described is verifiable in the diff and constitutes a real, if low-impact, security/correctness weakness introduced by this change.
